        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")
        
        value = self.regs[addr]
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        elif nbytes == 2:
            return value

class BMP280_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0xD0: 0x58,  # id
            0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
            0xF3: 0x00,  # status
            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00,  # temp_xlsb
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr in self.regs:
            value = self.regs[addr]
            if nbytes == 1:
                return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            return value
        return 0

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr in self.regs:
            if addr == 0xE0:  # reset
                if data == 0xB6:
                    self.reset_registers()
                return
            if addr == 0xF4:  # ctrl_meas
                if nbytes == 1:

                    data = (current_value & 0x00FF) | ((data << 8) & 0xFF00)

                    current_value = self.regs[addr]
                    data = (current_value & 0x00FF) | ((data << 8) & 0xFF00)
